title: Almost every point of the carrier inherits the approximate tangent planes of a containing set with n-dimensional growth
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, M, S, O subsets of R^(n+l) with O open, theta : R^(n+l) -> R and C real. Assume M is H^n-null-measurable, theta is a.e.-measurable for H^n restricted to M, theta is H^n-integrable on M cap O, H^n((M cap O) minus S) = 0, and H^n(S cap O cap B_r(z)) <= C r^n for every z and every r > 0 (B_r closed balls). Then for H^n-a.e. y in M (i.e. a.e. for H^n restricted to M): if y is in O, then every linear subspace P which is the approximate tangent space of S at y (Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n S y P) is the approximate tangent space of M with respect to theta at y (Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M theta y P). Here H^n = muHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (M S O : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (θ : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (C : ℝ), IsOpen O → NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) → AEMeasurable θ ((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict M) → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ O) (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) ((M ∩ O) \ S) = 0 → (∀ (z : Amb n ℓ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (S ∩ O ∩ closedBall z r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * r ^ n)) → ∀ᵐ y ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict M), y ∈ O → ∀ P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n S y P → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y P
